newsitem.title: POLAND: ING Barings recommends to buy Prochem.
newsitem.headline: ING Barings recommends to buy Prochem.

text.p: ING Baring Securities Limited recommended buying shares of Polish engineering firm Prochem SA , stressing its attractive valuation and saying the stock price could grow by 15-20 percent in medium-term, ING Baring said.
ING Baring said in its April report Prochem was valued at 12.1 times 1997 earnings, at 38 percent discount to the sector average.
"Prochem's attractive valuation and excellent 1997 first quarter earnings growth provides room for further 15-20 percent upside in the shares over the medium-term," it said.
ING Baring saw Prochem's 1997 net profit up to 5.5 million zlotys from 3.3 million last year on sales of 120 million in 1997, up from 46-million last year.
Prochem, which traded at 13.3 on April 21, when the report was issued, closed at 14.7 zlotys on Tuesday.
